# Lawyer
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Personnel.
2. Lawyers must report to court when summoned for a trial, and are expected to provide legal counsel to their clients, and other duties as assigned.
3. When arbitrating disputes between NanoTrasen-employed personnel, Lawyers are expected to be impartial and provide fair mediation to all parties involved.
4. Lawyers are to arbitrate on truth, and are not to lie or present false information during trials.
